title: King Oliver as described by Swayzee, Lips Page and Louis Metcalfe
summary: Swayzee sounded like King Oliver, and Metcalfe told Butler that Oliver was the master who could play everything and who fired him from the band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: He was telling me (unintelligible) so I said I'll keep that in mind, so now this was called Sammy Lewis Bamboo Follies, so and this King Swayzee, he said he so he didn't sound like Louie, he sound like King Oliver and all the fellows who had heard King Oliver, like Lips Page and Louis Metcalfe, well, they said King Oliver was the/thing and I asked Louis one time, was he really that good, and he said I am only a bandaid on his rib, he said that man was something

else. He said the man could play concert trumpet, he could play everything, everything he could do. He knows just when not to make a whole lot of notes, he know when to make a whole lot of notes, and he said and I was playing second trumpet with him and he fired me, and I cried. He run me out of the band for me to take a job across the street, that's what he told me.
